supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.title: Guide
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.subtitl: What you are, and how it all works
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_hu: You have not been touched yet. Anything that bites, blesses or marks you can start a path: a vampire's blood, a werewolf's bite, a witch's call, a hunter's oath. Your ladder is short until then.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_gh: You are turning. Drink human blood before the turning ends and you rise a vampire; fail and it ends in death. Until then only Path, Bloodline and this Guide open, and nothing on your path moves.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_va: You live on blood and the sun hurts you. Drink from the living to keep your thirst down, use Bite from the HUD, and climb the vampire ladder. Vampirism's own skill tree sits next to ours in the Skills page.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_or: The first of a bloodline. Your blood makes bottles and sires, and the ones you made answer to you. Nothing here can break your own line's bond, but others can try to sever theirs.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_hy: Vampire and werewolf at once. You feed in human form, shift under the moon, and your venom poisons vampires. The moon decides when you shift; a pack gives you strength.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_or: The first hybrid of a line: an Original and a werewolf in one body. You keep an Original's blood and a wolf's rank, and your hybrids answer to you.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_tr: Vampire, werewolf and witch in one. You carry the rules of all three ladders; the hub shows each one under its own name.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_he: A witch of the Heretic line: you draw on a coven's circle and answer for what it costs. Rites are where your path moves.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_wi: You cast through circles and rites. The Rite of Lineage reveals what blood carries, and your ladder grows with the rites you complete and the coven you keep.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_si: You take magic from what you touch. Siphoning feeds your own reserve, and the skills you buy shape what you can take and from whom.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_hu: You hunt the supernatural. Marks, instinct and a hunter's tools are your path; the creatures you track get weaker for you.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_we: You shift with the moon, and a full moon forces it. Your rank in the pack sets your strength; the Roar calls it together. Free Will gives you the shift at will.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.hub.bod: Home opens and closes it. The look button switches the style. The number keys 1 to 8 jump to a page, Tab moves through everything, Enter presses, Esc closes a dialog and then the hub.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.path.bo: A ladder of rungs for what you are. Finish a rung's tasks, claim them, and the rung rises: skill points and, with Tensura, EP follow. A task's tag says which mod it comes from.
Spend skill points on what your race's tree lists. A skill says what it needs and what it costs; Vampirism and Werewolves keep their own trees in their own tab.
One-off goals that unlock skills. Each lists its tasks; claim them as you finish.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.rites.b: Enchanted's rites, as the hub counts them: what a rite asks, what it gives, and which of your tasks it moves.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.bloodli: Who made you and whom you made, and the genes you carry. Undiscovered genes stay stoppered until a Rite of Revelation or your own awakening opens them.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.pack.bo: Your pack gives you a bonus while its members are near. Alphas lead, Betas follow, and who is in or out is decided here.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.loadout: Six slots on your HUD: R, F, V on the left of the hotbar and Z, X, C on the right. Pick an ability you know, then a slot. Bite is in slot 1 until you move it.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.moon.bo: Eight phases over eight days. A full moon can force a werewolf's shift; the almanac on the Path page shows the next days.
